anchor: Employee-count bands informed by DBT business population and small-business survey statistics; OWHS micro band includes zero employees. Not a Companies Act company-size classification.
notes: This field records an employee headcount band for the specified organisation and reference date. It does not determine statutory company size, turnover, balance-sheet size, employment including proprietors, or full-time equivalents. DBT's employer survey uses micro for 1-9 employees; OWHS retains zero in its existing <10 band for compatibility. Missing headcount must not be coded as zero. Applying these bands outside private-sector businesses is an OWHS categorisation, not a claim about the population covered by the cited statistics.
